title: Add live HTTP gateway smoke coverage
summary: Add an opt-in live test that spawns the real covenantd binary and asserts the HTTP gateway is reachable, rejects missing bearer auth, and accepts the minted operator token for basic queries.
expectedFailureModes: The daemon claims an HTTP gateway exists but the listener does not start reliably under a clean tempdir home.
Protected HTTP routes accidentally accept requests without bearer auth or with malformed tokens.
The operator token written to disk cannot authenticate through the HTTP gateway due to registry drift or token formatting mismatches.
The live test flaps because it does not wait for the HTTP listener before issuing requests.
verification: cd agent-os && cargo test -p covenantd --test live_http_gateway -- --ignored live_
nextAction: Implement the ignored live_http_gateway.rs test, wire it into the live coverage matrix, and mark the HTTP surface covered once it passes under validate.sh --quick.
